name: food_delivery_demo
domain_description: customer reviews of a food-delivery platform (restaurants, couriers and the ordering app)

Delivery.Late delivery: order arrived later than promised or took unusually long
Delivery.Courier behaviour: rude or careless driver, ignored drop-off instructions
Delivery.Order not delivered: order never arrived, or was marked delivered but not received

Food Quality.Poor taste: food tasted bad, bland, too salty, or quality declined
Food Quality.Undercooked or stale food: raw, undercooked, stale or old food

Order Accuracy.Missing items: items, drinks, sauces or cutlery missing from the order
Order Accuracy.Wrong items: received different items or someone else's order

Packaging.Spilled or leaking: food or drink spilled or leaked in transit
Packaging.Poor packaging: flimsy, crushed or badly arranged packaging

Customer Service.Unresponsive support: customer support slow, unhelpful or did not reply
Customer Service.Refund problems: refund refused, delayed, or given only as credit

App.App crashes or bugs: app crashes, freezes, logs out or misbehaves
App.Payment failure: payment declined, failed, or charged twice
App.Inaccurate tracking: order tracking or status was wrong or not updated

Pricing.Too expensive: prices or portions poor value for money
Pricing.Hidden or high fees: delivery/service fees too high or not shown upfront
Pricing.Promo not applied: discount or promo code did not work

Other.Other: a complaint that fits none of the issues above

notes: SYNTHETIC data: every review, restaurant and number was generated. Patterns reflect the generator's rules, not real customers.
Kept as the legacy demo for trend analysis (it has review dates).
